mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_comment (comment_id, board_id, member_id, content, created_at, is_secret, parent_id) VALUES (seq_board_comment.NEXTVAL, #{boardId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, SYSDATE, #{isSecret}, #{parentId, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id as commentId, c.board_id as boardId, c.member_id as memberId, c.content as content, c.created_at as createdAt, c.is_secret as isSecret, c.parent_id as parentId, m.nickname as writerNickname, m.membership as writerMembership, m.role as writerRole FROM board_comment c JOIN shop_member m ON c.member_id = m.member_id WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
